اقتنيت (form VIII)
# اِقْتَنَيْتُ (iqtanaytu) /iq.ta.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# اِقْتَنَيْتَ (iqtanayta) /iq.ta.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# اِقْتَنَيْتِ (iqtanayti) /iq.ta.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَنَى (iqtanā)
# اُقْتُنِيتُ (uqtunītu) /uq.tu.niː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
